name: Rajgor Castor Derivatives Ltd.
summary: Rajgor Castor Derivatives Ltd. is primarily engaged in the manufacturing, dealing, and trading of castor oil and its derivatives. The company's main products include Refined Castor Oil First Stage Grade (FSG), Castor De-Oiled Cake, and High Protein Castor De-Oiled Cake. These products serve various industries, with castor oil being utilized in pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, and biodiesel production, while the de-oiled cake is used for agricultural and animal feed purposes. The company operates on a business-to-business (B2B) model, catering to both domestic and international markets, having expanded its reach with exports starting in fiscal year 2023-24. Rajgor Castor Derivatives Ltd. operates within the agro-industrial chemical sector, specifically focusing on edible oils and solvent extraction by processing castor seeds. The company's manufacturing facility, located in Harij, Patan district, Gujarat, is strategically positioned within a major castor-growing region, ensuring access to raw materials sourced from local farmers and Agricultural Produce Market Committees (APMCs). The plant has a daily production capacity of 450 metric tons and includes units for crushing, refining, and producing de-oiled cakes. The company emphasizes quality control, efficient inventory management, and business development, aiming to maintain strong customer relationships through ethical practices and transparent, timely deliveries.
